        group(
          'foundations',
          '01 / Foundations',
          'Light throughout · 4 px rhythm · 21 color roles',
          card('Semantic palette', palette),
          card(
            'Type scale',
            stack(
              ...[
                ['title', '18 px · Page title'],
                ['heading', '15 px · Section heading'],
                ['control', '13 px · Forms & actions'],
                ['body', '12 px · Body & compact controls'],
                ['aux', '11 px · Units & supporting text'],
              ].map(([scale, text]) =>
                el('p', { class: 'gallery-type', 'data-scale': scale, text }),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          card(
            'Dimensions & layers',
            readout([
              ['Spacing', '4 / 8 / 12 / 16', 'px'],
              ['Controls · sm / md', '28 / 32', 'px'],
              ['Corners', '4 / 8', 'px'],
              ['Focus ring', '2 + 2 offset', 'px'],
              ['Elevations', '2', 'levels'],

                state: 'error',
                value: '-0.250',
                hint: 'Enter a thickness greater than zero.',
              }),
            ),
          ),
          card(
            'Select / native options',
            stack(
              select('Material'),
              select('Focused select', { state: 'focus' }),
              select('Unavailable material', { state: 'disabled' }),
              select('Invalid material', { state: 'error', hint: 'Select a supported material.' }),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      )

gallery.append(
        group(
          'contrast',
          '07 / Text contrast',
          'sRGB luminance · no threshold rounding · disabled opacity explicitly 1',
          contrastCard,
